capabilities.confirmDisableAi: Turning off AI will discard your AI model picks, indexing policy, and remote Ollama configuration. Continue?

appsStep.title: What do you want NOMAD to do?
appsStep.subtitle: Select the capabilities you need. You can always add more later.
appsStep.allInstalled: All available capabilities are already installed!
appsStep.moreAppsText: Notes, data tools, and the full catalog of add-on apps are available any time in Supply Depot.

mapsStep.title: Choose Map Regions
mapsStep.subtitle: Select map region collections to download for offline use. You can always download more regions later.
mapsStep.mapsManagerHint: Only need a specific country, or want the whole world? Individual countries and a full global map can be installed any time from the <link>Maps Manager</link>.
mapsStep.empty: No map collections available at this time.

contentStep.title: Choose Content
contentStep.subtitleInformation: Select content categories for offline knowledge.
contentStep.subtitleOther: Configure content for your selected capabilities.
contentStep.noContentCapabilities: No content-based capabilities selected. You can skip this step or go back to select capabilities that require content.

creatorPacksStep.title: Stock Creator Packs
creatorPacksStep.subtitle: Branded video collections from creators, downloaded for offline viewing in Kiwix.
creatorPacksStep.empty: No creator packs available right now.

aiStep.title: Configure {{name}}
aiStep.subtitle: Choose models to download and set how {{name}} handles new content.
aiStep.modelsText: Select models to download for offline AI
aiStep.remoteMessage: Models are managed on the remote machine. You can add models from Settings > AI Assistant after setup, note this is only supported when using Ollama, not LM Studio and other OpenAI API software.
aiStep.noModels: No recommended AI models available at this time.
aiStep.autoIndexText: When you add new ZIMs, documents, or curated content, should {{name}} index them automatically so it can search them while answering your questions?
aiStep.changeLater: You can change this any time from the Knowledge Base panel inside AI Chat.

reviewStep.title: Review Your Selections
reviewStep.subtitle: Review your choices before starting the setup process.
reviewStep.noSelectionsMessage: You haven't selected anything to install or download. You can go back to make selections or go back to the home page.
reviewStep.autoIndexAlways: New content will be <bold>indexed automatically</bold> as it arrives so {{name}} can search it.
reviewStep.autoIndexManual: New content will <bold>wait for you to opt in</bold> from the Knowledge Base panel before {{name}} indexes it.
reviewStep.readyMessage: Click 'Complete Setup' to begin installing apps and downloading content. This may take some time depending on your internet connection and the size of the downloads.

offline.title: No Internet Connection
offline.message: You'll need an internet connection to proceed. Please connect to the internet and try again.

notifications.offlineFinish: You must have an internet connection to complete the setup.
notifications.completed: Setup wizard completed! Your selections are being processed.
notifications.error: An error occurred during setup. Some items may not have been processed.

complete.offlineMessage: It looks like you're not connected to the internet. Installing apps and downloading content will require an internet connection.
complete.backgroundMessage: Feel free to leave this page at any time - your app installs and downloads will continue in the background! Please note, the Information Library (if installed) may be unavailable until all initial downloads complete.

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia
wikipedia.subtitle: Select your preferred Wikipedia package
wikipedia.downloadingMessage: Downloading Wikipedia... This may take a while for larger packages.
wikipedia.failedMessage: Wikipedia download failed. Select a package and try again.

tierModal.intro: Select a tier based on your storage capacity and needs. Higher tiers include all content from lower tiers.
tierModal.embedEstimate: <bold>+~{{size}}</bold> of additional storage if these are indexed for the AI Assistant
tierModal.embedEstimateUnknown: (estimate excludes some files we have no prior data for)
tierModal.policyAlways: Your <bold>Auto-index</bold> setting is <bold>Always</bold>, so these files will be indexed automatically once downloaded. You can change this in the Knowledge Base settings.
tierModal.policyManual: Your <bold>Auto-index</bold> setting is <bold>Manual</bold>, so these files will sit unindexed until you opt in from the Knowledge Base settings.
tierModal.info: You can change your selection at any time. Click Submit to confirm your choice.
